baseShell.instruction: Reuse the supplied site's engineering shell/infrastructure where compatible. Do not carry over its visual identity. Any visual output must be regenerated by NEXUS from this project's own evidence and constraints.

visual: The site must use white and elegant gray as the requested color family.
No gold anywhere in the site.
The result must feel boutique and professional.
The WhatsApp action must be visibly green as explicitly requested by the user.
Do not reuse or manually reinterpret assistant-created mockups from earlier attempts.
functional: Provide a WhatsApp action using the supplied phone number 5543432221.
Provide a map/location experience for the supplied clinic address.

Include 10 to 15 Google Maps reviews only when each review is fetched from a real verifiable source at implementation time; if that evidence cannot be fetched, the review requirement must remain blocked/NOT_TESTED rather than fabricated.
process: No manual design decisions by the operator.
All creative, visual, compositional, typographic, chromatic, spatial, motion and content-presentation decisions must come from NEXUS.
Use only client-supplied or explicitly authorized photography/assets.
Do not invent awards, statistics, testimonials, reviews, prices, credentials, treatment claims, history, hours or outcomes.
Any missing creative capability must be implemented or connected inside NEXUS, tested, and then re-run; never bypass the engine.
